design_description: A striking geometric design built on the Prism template, featuring a repeating pattern of elongated interlocking triangular shapes. The alternating green and white prisms create a bold optical effect, giving the jersey strong rhythm, depth, and movement across the entire body. Gold collar and sleeve cuffs introduce a premium accent, while the green logos and crest integrate naturally into the overall palette. The clean all-over pattern is balanced by minimal trim, allowing the geometric motif to remain the focal point of the design. Overall, the jersey feels modern, energetic, and distinctive, offering a fresh interpretation of classic green-and-white club colors.
